heading_en: Revocation of Approval of a Special Exclusion
summary_ja: 除外特例の承認を受けた後、除外を継続することが不適当と認める場合の承認の取消しを定める。
summary_en: Allows the Commissioner to revoke an approved special exclusion where continued exclusion is deemed inappropriate.
paragraphs: The Commissioner of the Financial Services Agency may revoke an approval under Article 292 or Article 295 where the Commissioner finds it inappropriate for an Ultimate Designated Parent Company that has obtained that approval to continue to exclude the consolidated subsidiary corporation, etc. or business unit, or the special loss, for which it was approved.
